STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_092391.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_092391.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_092391 (
    in,
    rc,
    regime,
    exp,
    mant
);
  function [31:0] log2;
    input reg [31:0] value;
    begin
      value = value - 1;
      for (log2 = 0; value > 0; log2 = log2 + 1) value = value >> 1;
    end
  endfunction

  parameter N = 16;
  parameter Bs = log2(N);
  parameter es = 2;

  input [N-1:0] in;
  output rc;
  output [Bs-1:0] regime;
  output [es-1:0] exp;
  output [N-es-1:0] mant;

  wire [N-1:0] xin = in;
  assign rc = xin[N-2];

  wire [ N-1:0] xin_r = rc ? ~xin : xin;

  wire [Bs-1:0] k;
  LOD_N #(
      .N(N)
  ) xinst_k (
      .in ({xin_r[N-2:0], rc ^ 1'b0}),
      .out(k)
  );

  assign regime = rc ? k - 1 : k;

  wire [N-1:0] xin_tmp;
  DSR_left_N_S #(
      .N(N),
      .S(Bs)
  ) ls (
      .a({xin[N-3:0], 2'b0}),
      .b(k),
      .c(xin_tmp)
  );

  assign exp  = xin_tmp[N-1:N-es];
  assign mant = xin_tmp[N-es-1:0];

endmodule
